description: This file defines API endpoints related to class management in a FastAPI application. It includes routes for creating, listing, retrieving, and updating class entities, utilizing dependency injection for services and role-based access control.

methods.name: create_class( payload: ClassCreate, svc: ClassesService = Depends(ClassesService), _: None = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.admin])), )
methods.description: Creates a new class entry; accessible to admins.

methods.name: list_classes(svc: ClassesService = Depends(ClassesService))
methods.description: Returns a list of all classes.

methods.name: get_class(class_id: str, svc: ClassesService = Depends(ClassesService))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific class by its ID, throws 404 if not found.

methods.name: update_class( class_id: str, payload: ClassUpdate, svc: ClassesService = Depends(ClassesService), _: None = Depends(require_roles([UserRole.admin])), )
methods.description: Updates an existing class by its ID; accessible to admins.
